'''Jacen Solo's lightsaber''' was a weapon constructed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] in [[23 ABY]]. He used it until his fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], at which point it was confiscated by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]. As a result of losing his first lightsaber, he constructed a [[Darth Caedus' lightsaber|red-bladed lightsaber]] to compensate for the loss of [[Gender/Legends|his]] first one and wielded this second lightsaber until his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[41 ABY]] where he used it in a [[Battle of Uroro Station|duel]] with his [[Twin/Legends|twin sister]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].

==History==
===Creation and training===
By the age of thirteen, Jacen began attending his uncle Luke Skywalker's [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]]. There, along with the rest of his class, he constructed his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], using a precious, powerful [[Corusca gem]] acquired from Lando Calrissian's [[GemDiver Station]] to power the weapon. At one point, during an ill-fated sparring exercise, Jacen accidentally cut off [[Tenel Ka Djo]]'s left arm with his lightsaber after [[Tenel Ka Djo's lightsaber|her own lightsaber]] failed.

===Jedi tool and Sith weapon===
Jacen fought in the Yuuzhan Vong War alongside his family and friends. During the [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Duro]], he used it against [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]], who was torturing his mother, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. After he was captured during a [[Mission to Myrkr|disastrous mission]] to [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]], Jacen's lightsaber was taken by the mysterious [[Fosh/Legends|Fosh]] Jedi [[Vergere]]. Vergere later returned the lightsaber to Jacen, however, and he wielded it for the remainder of the war, as well as the later [[Dark Nest Crisis]] and [[Swarm War]].
[[File:Second_Battle_of_Roche.jpg|left|thumb|Jacen battled his sister, who he had unleashed a surge of Force Lightning on.]]
During [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Jacen turned to the Dark Side under the influence of the Sith Lady [[Lumiya]]. However, Jacen initially still used his Jedi weapon, much like his [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|grandfather]] almost [[19 BBY/Legends|sixty years earlier]]. He used it to kill his former apprentice [[Nelani Dinn]] and duel the bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] aboard his flagship, the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. Weeks later, he used the lightsaber against his aunt, [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], when [[Skirmish on Kavan|she tried to assassinate him]] after learning of his treachery. Jacen proved less than a match for Mara, and he only barely survived the encounter by killing her with a [[Poison dart/Legends|poison dart]], becoming the Sith Lord Darth Caedus thereafter.

===Final use and confiscation===
The lightsaber's final use in Caedus' hands was against Luke Skywalker himself in a vicious duel aboard the ''Anakin Solo'' during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Each severely injured the other before [[Ben Skywalker]], Luke's son whom Caedus had captured prior, plunged a [[vibrodagger]] into Caedus's back. Caedus's lightsaber remained lit even after he dropped it, but as he continued to reach for it, Ben took it and prepared to finish him off, believing Caedus was responsible for his mother's death. However, Luke, realizing how close he and his son had come toward the Dark Side, convinced Ben to spare Caedus' life. As the battered Skywalkers fled the ''Anakin Solo'', Ben gave Jacen's lightsaber to Luke. What became of the lightsaber afterward is unknown.
[[File:Jaina_vs_Caedus.jpg|thumb|Jacen wielded his second lightsaber against his sister, Jaina Solo.]]
After recovering from his battle with his uncle and cousin, Caedus later built a [[Darth Caedus' lightsaber|red-bladed lightsaber]] to compensate for the loss of [[Gender/Legends|his]] original lightsaber. As per the usual traditions of the Sith, he wielded that [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] until his death in [[41 ABY]] at the hands of his [[Twin/Legends|twin sister]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]].<ref name="Inferno" />
